concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-nab-change-your-bank-account]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted NAB-path article for Control Panel submission of a bank statement or signed bank letter to request a new Australia-based business checking account; upload is not acceptance, approval or change-completion proof, and the page does not imply a settlement currency or sibling-route policy
warnings: Keep the Australia-based business-checking condition scoped to this captured NAB path; do not infer a currency or transfer it to sibling account or processor routes.
Describe the Control Panel upload as a request route, not evidence of document acceptance, approval or completed account change.
